answer: Re-attestations are stored in glacier and thread lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the reef graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1141 impostors cost 546 times the honest price and take 2 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
